concepts.prompt: One single isolated large grassy earth hill terrain piece for a cozy fantasy meadow, seen in clear 3/4 view from slightly above. Wide and low: an oval footprint about 1.3 times longer than it is wide, and its height only about one sixth of its length, like a soft rolling burrow hill in the reference landscapes. Soft rolling dome silhouette with a gently undulating double-crested top; flanks slope outward and flare softly into a wide grassy foot at ground level. No straight edges, no vertical cliff faces, no flat walls, no undercut, no overhang. Thick lush grass covers the top and most of the flanks; on the steeper lower flanks the grass parts to show a few soft layered terraces of exposed brown soil banks with rounded lips, and a few rounded mossy grey rock outcrops half-buried in the slope, like the rocky hillside in the reference. A few gnarled exposed roots and four or five small round leafy shrubs; no tall trees. At the base of one long side, a single rounded cave-mouth notch: a dark arched burrow opening, about one tenth of the hill's length wide and about a quarter of the hill's height tall, framed by exposed twisting tree roots above and a few rounded boulders at its sides. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, hand-painted look, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people, no animals, no buildings. Palette: earth brown #6b5236, meadow grass green #6f9a3c with lighter yellow-green tips, weathered stone grey #8c8778, soft green moss. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere, no flowers in red. Flat ground contact and flat underside.

concepts.prompt: Edit the first image (the grassy burrow hill with the root-framed cave mouth) and keep its design: the same soft double-crested rolling grassy hill, the same rounded dark cave-mouth notch framed by twisting roots and small boulders at the base of the long front side, the same mossy grey rocks and small round shrubs, and the same hand-painted Palworld / Animo style. Change one thing: it must NOT look like a diorama or a cake on a base. Remove the continuous vertical brown soil skirt around the bottom edge. Instead the grass flows all the way down to the ground on every side and the hill flares out into a wide, thin, gently feathered grassy foot that meets the ground at a very shallow angle, like the rolling hills in the second image. Keep exposed brown soil only as two or three short, soft, curved terrace lips partway up the flanks and around the cave mouth, never as a band around the whole base. Wide and low: about 1.3 times longer than wide, height about one sixth of the length. No straight edges, no vertical faces, no undercut. Single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no people, no animals, no buildings, no trees. Palette: earth brown #6b5236, meadow grass green #6f9a3c with lighter yellow-green tips, stone grey #8c8778, soft moss. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat underside.
